messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the long‑weekend holidays that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, or is observed on a Monday when it lands on a weekend.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Province(s) affected | Notes |
|---------|---------|----------------------|-------|
| **Jan 2** | New Year’s Day (observed) | All provinces | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday Jan 1, so it was observed on Monday Jan 2. |
| **Feb 20** | Family Day | Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island | Family Day is a statutory holiday in these provinces; it fell on a Monday. |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in these provinces; it fell on a Friday. |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | All provinces | Victoria Day is a statutory holiday in all provinces; it fell on a Monday. |
| **Jul 3** | Canada Day (observed) | All provinces | Canada Day fell on Saturday Jul 1, so it was observed on Monday Jul 3. |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | All provinces | Labour Day is a statutory holiday in all provinces; it fell on a Monday. |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | All provinces | Thanksgiving is a statutory holiday in all provinces; it fell on a Monday. |
| **Nov 13** | Remembrance Day (observed) | All provinces | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday Nov 11, so it was observed on Monday Nov 13. |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | All provinces | Christmas Day fell on a Monday, creating a long weekend. |

### Provincial add‑ons (optional)

Some provinces have additional statutory holidays that also create long weekends in 2023:

| Province | Holiday | Date | Long‑Weekend? |
|----------|---------|------|---------------|
| Prince Edward Island | St. George’s Day | Apr 23 (Friday) | Yes – long weekend Apr 21‑23 |
| Newfoundland & Labrador | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 (Wednesday) | No – not a long weekend |
| (others) | – | – | – |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> Store each holiday as an object with fields such as `name`, `date`, `province`, and `isLongWeekend`.  
> When generating a calendar view, flag the days that belong to a long weekend so users can see at a glance which weekends offer extra time off.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the data in a specific format (JSON, CSV, etc.) or if you need the list broken down by province!
